title: lease-based-shadowing-with-tenant-quarantine-and-dynamic-sampling
creator: Avery Malik
body:
Goal: Build a production-safe shadowing/mirroring pipeline that duplicates a configurable fraction of live production requests to alternate model variants (canaries, non-prod replicas, or new quantized variants) while bounding incremental cost and avoiding cross-tenant leakage. The pipeline should support lease-based tenant quarantine, dynamic sampling tuned by tenant budget usage, per-request isolation (headers, metadata redaction), and observability hooks for rollout/auto-rollback decisions.

Scope: server-side gateway + mirror-orchestrator + telemetry exporters. We will not change model weights or runtime internals in this ticket, but will add lightweight adapters for KV cache tagging and indicate when mirrored sequences should be excluded from metrics.

Design decisions so far:
- Sampling model: adaptive token-budget governor that consumes a tenant's mirror-credits ledger. Each tenant has a daily mirror budget; the governor maps budget to sampling probability with sigmoid decay to avoid abrupt drops. We selected a credit-first model (leases) so quota updates are transactional and bounded.
- Quarantine/lease mechanism: mirror requests acquire a short-lived lease token per-tenant from the Mirror Lease Service (MLS). If the tenant exceeds their budget or a safety signal triggers, new leases are rejected and mirroring is paused for that tenant until the next refill window. This avoids cross-tenant budget bleed.
- Isolation: mirrored requests run with stripped PII headers and an injected synthetic-tenant-id to avoid writes to tenant-scoped downstream systems. All mirrored responses are tagged "mirror=true" and routed to a dedicated observability pipeline.
- Cost controls: global budget ceilings + per-tenant throttles; emergency circuit-breaker tied to infra cost telemetry that can disable mirroring cluster-wide.
- Observability: mirror traffic emits a compact sample of tokens-per-request, estimated mirrored-cost, and a deterministic shadow-fingerprint to allow deduping in downstream eval jobs. We will also push per-variant regression metrics to console/rollouts.

Trade-offs:
- Adds ~0.6–1.5ms median extra latency in the gateway path for mirror decisioning — acceptable vs alternative of out-of-band tap approach which would lack per-tenant budget enforcement.
- More operational surface area (MLS, mirror-orchestrator). We mitigate by reusing existing token-store and autoscaler patterns.
- Sampling introduces statistical noise in quality evaluation; plan to increase sampling for high-value tenants and provide stratified sampling hooks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Gateway implements mirror decision path with lease acquisition fallback within 50ms (p95) and emits metrics for lease latency.
acceptance_criteria: Lease acquisition and decision path implemented in gateway; latency p95 < 50ms
Per-tenant mirror budgets tracked and enforced; tests for budget exhaustion behavior
Quarantine flow pauses mirroring for tenants that exceed thresholds and logs a clear audit trail
Dynamic sampling algorithm implemented and can be configured per-tenant via Console
Mirrored requests are isolated: PII headers redacted and synthetic tenant id injected
End-to-end test harness validates mirrored request delivery to canary model and dedupable telemetry
implementation_notes: Mirror Lease Service (MLS): lease keys are namespaced by tenant-id + window-date to simplify refunds and windowing
Use existing token-store backed by Redis cluster with fail-open only when explicitly allowed by feature flag
Deterministic shadow-fingerprint = SHA256(trace_id || request_path || truncated_payload_hash) to aid offline joins
Mirror-orchestrator will maintain per-variant blueprints (endpoint, model_version, quantization_tag) and return 202 on accepted mirror copy
Telemetry will use compact batch protocol to avoid high cardinality metrics — we will emit counters and sampled histograms to Console
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): feature-flagged in dev stack, internal load tests, e2e harness runs against canary replicas
Phase 1 (alpha): enable for engineering tenants only with high sampling (10%) and manual monitoring for 72h
Phase 2 (beta): per-customer opt-in via Console for a small subset of production tenants (1–2% sampling), 7-day monitoring
Phase 3 (gradual): expand sampling using adaptive governor, enable cost auto-throttling and circuit-breaker
Phase 4 (full): default low-rate shadowing for new model rollouts with auto-rollback hooks wired to Console regressions
tests: Unit: MLS lease acquisition/release, budget accounting, backpressure behavior
Integration: gateway->MLS->mirror-orchestrator happy-path and error-mode (MLS down, fail-open/closed toggle)
Load: 2x production QPS shadowed at 5% with observability enabled to measure cost delta
Chaos: simulate delayed mirror-orchestrator, validate circuit-breaker disables mirroring within 30s
dependencies_notes: Depends on ENG-100412 (mirror broker refactor) for stable mirror buffering and ENG-84321 for token-store scaling. Coordinate with infra before enabling wide rollout.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Excessive cost spike if governor misconfigured — Mitigation: global emergency circuit-breaker and budget dry-run mode
Risk: Leakage of tenant PII in mirrored requests — Mitigation: header striplist and automated PII regex scanner in gateway pre-send hook
Risk: Telemetry cardinality explosion — Mitigation: sampled histograms and deterministic fingerprinting to dedupe
comments: 2026-02-12 Avery Malik: Initial proposal posted. Asked product for acceptable daily mirror cost per tenant; PM suggested $10/day for small tenants.
2026-02-18 Jordan Lee: Implemented MLS prototype; added Redis-backed lease table with TTL-based windowing. PR posted: runtime#3170.
2026-02-24 Design review (Marina Ortiz): Approved isolation approach; requested clear UX for tenant opt-in and audit entries in Console.
2026-03-01 Load testing: 5% shadowing at 2k RPS increased token-cost by ~2.3%; circuit-breaker threshold tuned to 5% daily overage.
2026-03-04 Security review: initial checklist passed; pending follow-up on PII redaction regex coverage (sec assigned to ENG-118900).
2026-03-05 Jordan Lee: Merged gateway decisioning stub under feature flag. Next: hook MLS into Console config and wire metrics to rollout dashboard.
